Summarize a comparison by measure

Source: R/summary.R
diff_summary.Rd

Counts of each status for every measure of a diff_table() result, and, for the usual one-row-per-value shape, how large the differences are.

Usage

diff_summary(d)

Arguments

d

A result of diff_table().

Value

A data.table with one row per measure, in the benchmark's column order (a single row when there are no measures): metric, n, n_same, n_changed, n_only_x, n_only_y, and for the "cells" shape max_abs_diff, mean_abs_diff, rmse and max_rel_diff (NA for a measure with no finite pair).

Details

The magnitudes are taken over every value compared on both sides where both source values are finite. They are filtered on the source values, not on diff: two finite values can differ by more than the largest double, and filtering on the difference would drop exactly that value and report the largest difference in the table as 0. rmse is computed with scaling, so squaring cannot overflow either.

Examples

x <- data.frame(id = 1:3, amount = c(10, 20, 30), rate = c(1, 1, 1))
y <- data.frame(id = 1:3, amount = c(10, 25, 27), rate = c(1, 1, 1))
diff_summary(diff_table(x, y))
#>    metric     n n_same n_changed n_only_x n_only_y max_abs_diff mean_abs_diff
#>    <char> <int>  <int>     <int>    <int>    <int>        <num>         <num>
#> 1: AMOUNT     3      1         2        0        0            5      2.666667
#> 2:   RATE     3      3         0        0        0            0      0.000000
#>        rmse max_rel_diff
#>       <num>        <num>
#> 1: 3.366502          0.2
#> 2: 0.000000          0.0
